title: The Nasrid and Charles V Palaces: Alhambra Audio Tour with Context
description: A short audio tour through the Alhambra from the Gate of Justice, covering the Renaissance palace that Emperor Charles V built inside it and the Nasrid Palaces. An Alhambra ticket is required.

title: Enchanting Granada: A Walking Tour of the Historical Centre and Lower Albaicín
description: A long walk from the fountain in Plaza Bib-Rambla through the old silk market, the cathedral and Royal Chapel, and up along the river into the lower Albaicín, Granada’s old Muslim quarter.

title: The Albaicín and Sacromonte’s Iconic Sights: A Granada Walking Tour
place: Monastery of Santa Isabel la Real
description: A walk through the upper Albaicín, past old city gates, a Nasrid palace, and viewpoints over the Alhambra, then down into the cave houses of Sacromonte.

title: Vibrant Multicultural Realejo: Granada’s Old Jewish Quarter
description: A walk from the town hall up the steep streets of the Realejo, once the Jewish quarter, with stops at churches, squares, and viewpoints toward the Alhambra.

title: Central Granada and its architectural highlights
description: An architect leads a walk through the old center, explaining the buildings: the Moorish Corral del Carbón inn, the silk market, the Royal Chapel, the cathedral, and the Monastery of San Jerónimo.
